title: 连续语流中的词组
goal: 辨认连续语流中的词组边界，并结合完整词组判断句意。

points.label: 从连续语流中辨认词组边界
结合完整词组判断句意

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）
sources.used: 听力理解的课程内容依据

body.p: 连续语流中，功能词通常读得比实义词轻、短。相邻的词常常连读。辨认词组要结合句法和上下文。
例如 I can attend 表示可以出席，I have to attend 表示必须出席。can 和 have to 都读得轻，听清这两个功能词才能分清句意。

cards.title: 功能词的弱读
rows: I can check the list this evening.
We have to return the equipment today.
They plan to visit the studio.
cards.note: 功能词在句中被强调时，读得较重。

cards.title: 辅音与元音的连接
rows: pick 的末辅音连接 up
I'll pick up the parcel after lunch.
turn 的末辅音连接 off
Please turn off the printer tonight.
send 的末辅音连接 it
I'll send it to the editor tomorrow.
move 的末辅音连接 in
cards.note: 连读只改变声音的衔接，词组的拼写和语法不变。

cards.title: 词组切分与句意
rows: I can check the list. / I have to check the list.
I need to call Mei. / I'll write and call Mei.
需要打电话与写信并打电话
I'll pick up the parcel. / I'll send it tomorrow.
They'll move in Friday. / They'll turn off the lights.

body.box:
A: Is the parcel still at the desk?
B: Yes. I have to pick it up before the desk closes.
A: I'll call the desk and check its closing time.

What must B do?
1. Collect the parcel before closing.
2. Deliver the parcel to the desk.
3. Close the desk after the call.
4. Call the desk about its hours.

body.p: have to 表示必须，pick it up 表示领取包裹，第一项与此对应。第四项的打电话是 A 的安排。

lines.text: Is the printer still running?
Yes. I'll turn it off after this page.

items.stem: What will the second speaker do after the page?
items.why: turn it off 表示关闭打印机，第二项保留动作和对象。

lines.text: Can you collect the samples?
Yes, I can pick them up at noon.

items.stem: Which phrase describes the second speaker's plan?
items.why: I can pick them up 表示中午领取样品，第三项保留完整词组。

lines.text: Are the keys ready?
Yes, so we can move in tomorrow.

items.stem: What can the speakers do tomorrow?
options: Check whether the keys are ready.
items.why: can move in tomorrow 表示明天可以搬入，第二项对应这一安排。

lines.text: Has Mei seen the schedule?
Not yet. I have to send it to her.

items.stem: Which phrase expresses the second speaker's obligation?
items.why: have to send it 表示需要发送，第一项保留表示必要性的词组。

lines.text: The forms are ready. Can we leave them here?
We have to hand them in at the office. I can take them there after lunch.
I'll call and tell the office they're coming.

items.stem: What must the speakers do with the forms?
options: Ask the office for new forms.
items.why: have to hand them in at the office 表示必须把表格交到办公室，即第二项。

items.stem: Which phrase describes the first speaker's two actions?
items.why: I'll call and tell 用 and 连接打电话和告知两个动作，即第一项。

lines.text: Is the projector ready for the meeting?
Yes. I can set it up before the guests arrive.

items.stem: Which phrase describes the second speaker's offer?
items.why: I can set it up 表示可以安装好投影仪，第三项保留谓语词组。

lines.text: Will the gallery keep the paintings overnight?
No. We have to pick them up this afternoon.

items.stem: What must the speakers do this afternoon?
options: Leave the paintings in the gallery.
Collect the paintings from the gallery.
Deliver new paintings to the gallery.
Arrange the paintings inside the gallery.
items.why: have to pick them up 表示必须领取画作，第二项对应这一必要动作。

lines.text: Does the director have the revised program?
Not yet. I'll send it to her and call her afterwards.

items.stem: Which phrase identifies the second speaker's first action?
items.why: 依据是 I'll send it to her and call her afterwards。先发送节目单，后打电话，即第四项。

lines.text: The lights are on in the workshop.
I'll turn them off when the last group leaves.

items.stem: What will the second speaker do after the last group leaves?
options: Let the last group switch off the lights.
Switch off the lights before the group leaves.
items.why: 依据是 I'll turn them off when the last group leaves，them 指 lights。说话人自己在最后一组离开时关灯，即第一项。

lines.text: What supplies are needed for the labels?
We need pens and paper. The envelopes are already here.

items.stem: Which phrase names the supplies still needed?
items.why: pens and paper 由 and 连接两项所需用品；envelopes 已经备好。

lines.text: Are the painters finished with the apartment?
Yes. We can move in on Saturday, but the keys won't arrive until Friday.

items.stem: What does the second speaker say about Saturday?
options: The painters must finish the apartment.
The keys will be delivered that day.
The apartment will be painted again.
The speakers can occupy the apartment.
items.why: can move in on Saturday 表示周六可以搬入，即第四项。钥匙在周五送到，不是周六。
